_about: Training data for the learned injection detector (app/injection_clf.py, trained by scripts/train_injection_clf.py). Written 2026-11-01 AFTER tests/data/injection_heldout_v2.json was committed. Must never contain texts from either held-out set (heldout_attacks/heldout_benign in adversarial_prompts.json, or injection_heldout_v2.json) or from the FP evaluation sets (demo script, agent chips, benchmark queries, benign_hard_negatives, benign_hard_negatives_v2); tests/test_injection_clf.py checks for exact and near duplicates. The 54 known attacks in adversarial_prompts.json are added to the attack side by the training script. Templates are expanded as a cartesian product, keeping every `stride`-th combination, so expansion is deterministic.
